# Original snapshot drawing-semantics fixture

This isolated extension of hero-float-probe observes renderingIntent/isMask/shouldInterpolate/decode on the same retained renderer-return CGImage, only after all original PNGs and the existing window teardown and before original release. The original float on/off lifecycle, raw exports, phase/native/cache/normal/window gates and unchanged actual Hero/Image/Style sources remain. No new snapshot, image, context, provider read, draw, layer request or color conversion is added. Backing observation is explicitly off.

A same-key match in the first two existing primary descriptors supplies the original color-space reference; cleanup descriptors are excluded. Safe decode requires nonmask RGB3 and64bit CGFloat; nil is distinct, nonnil reads at most6 values, finite Double values and exact bits preserve signed zero. Failures append a partial raw record before the original throw/finalization/release/nonzero path. The raw record export timer precedes this separate semantic timer; the overall finish duration includes it.

The four attributes do not prove full CGImage semantics or a color cause. A new-SDK arm64/min13 build-once signed package must run off/on on13/14 with same-host prior/default and off/on12ROI controls before interpretation. This source README does not claim those future runs passed. Static same-image opaque/up p0/p1 endpoints do not accept real-flight/full-app/HDR/other-input behavior. No product template changed.

product_source_commit remains b08db54e01ac2ec54fb84e6f2a70041f1f4c3604 for frozen original source identity; fixture_base_commit5eca0e5904117d131e1129302d50d357e4234a15 identifies the copied current probe folder. source-provenance.json maps all retained inputs and records base hashes; historical source/provenance files are not new runtime evidence.
